content: {"episode_id":"ep-05096","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-50","necessity_paragraph":"Atlas denied CPT 93229 for mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring under CO-50 as not medically necessary. The clinical indication note states the patient presents with intermittent palpitations and episodes of dizziness that are concerning for arrhythmia in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency, consistent with the submitted diagnosis codes I34.0, R00.2, and R42. Per the note, mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to capture continuous rhythm data and correlate these symptomatic events with potential cardiac dysrhythmias. We request reconsideration of the CO-50 determination and payment of the outstanding balance of 679.19."}
